# Narrative Scope

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NarrativeScope`](gmeow-NarrativeScope.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NarrativeScope>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The umbrella category of things a narrative role can be relative to — a creative work (protagonist of the trilogy), a narrative reference frame (protagonist of the continuity), or a content segment (protagonist of one chapter). A NAMED class (the [`IntentionalMoment`](gmeow-IntentionalMoment.md)/RiskFactor precedent) so roleScope carries a generator-visible range and the relator-arity gate sees the end. Never instantiated directly.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:NarrativeScope`](gmeow-NarrativeScope.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
